topic: Sources, Uses, and Safety of Heat and Light
key_concepts: The sun is a natural source of heat and light
Volcanoes are natural sources of heat and light
Fireflies are natural sources of light
Table lamps and traffic lights are artificial sources of light
Heat and light have everyday uses
Keeping a safe distance from the television protects the eyes from too much light
Hot pots and stoves should not be touched while cooking
Umbrellas or hats protect against the sun's heat at noon
Adequate light is needed when reading
Playing outside in extreme heat is unsafe
Candles should be kept away from flammable objects and placed on nonflammable holders
Tongs should be used when grilling to avoid burns
